title: Enigma Tahta sing Adoh
intro: Raja sing kuwasa, sing diberkahi karo panguwasa sing luar biasa, ngadhepi tantangan aneh sing nglibatake ratu saka tanah sing adoh. Raja kasebut ngupaya nduduhake kekuwatan lan kawicaksanan ilahi, miwiti kedadeyan sing luar biasa sing nglawan hukum wektu lan ruang. Apa sampeyan bisa nyimpulake rincian kedadeyan ajaib iki?
clues: Sawijining panguasa diwenehi kekuwatan sing gedhe banget, kalebu ngontrol makhluk sing ora katon lan kemampuan kanggo nguwasani angin.
Penguasa iki nampa kabar babagan ratu sugih sing nyembah srengenge, lan mutusake kanggo ngundang dheweke menyang kraton.
Sadurunge ratu rawuh, penguasa kasebut ngungkapake kepinginan kanggo nggawa tahta kekuasaane sing megah saka kerajaan sing adoh.
Jin sing perkasa nawarake arep njupuk barang kasebut sadurunge penguasa mau ngadeg saka dewan perwakilan rakyat.
Nanging, wong sing nduweni kawruh sing jero babagan Kitab Suci bisa nemokake informasi kanthi luwih cepet, ngrampungake tugas kasebut sajrone sekedhik mripat.
Sawisé barang mau tekan, panggedhe mrentahake supaya barang kasebut diowahi kanggo nguji kapinteran lan persepsi ratu nalika pungkasane tekan kraton.
verse: It was said to her, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace paved with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds." (An-Naml 27:44)
arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِي الصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
